newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: PepsiCo to close its Geneva office.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo to close its Geneva office.

text.p: U.S. soft drink giant PepsiCo plans to close its office in the Swiss city of Geneva, which handled Middle East and North African businesses, and move it to Dubai, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.
The small representative office, opened in 1993 and employing three people, would be shut down by the end of February, the spokeswoman said.
"We're moving to Dubai to get closer to our clients," she said. "All the senior staff have already gone."

PepsiCo handles its Swiss business from the German-speaking part of the country. The Geneva office looked after marketing, sales and relations in Europe for Middle Eastern and North African markets, the spokeswoman said.
